note: What a server sends to set values of group 2 on a unit. The header names the unit.

fields.name: which
fields.note: Says which of the group's values follow, one bit each, lowest first.

fields.name: values
fields.note: The values themselves, four bytes each, in the order the bits above name them. A client reads one only for a bit below the number of values the unit holds in the group, and nothing after the bits where the unit holds no such group.
